body_mapping_calibration.hypothesis: A deterministic initial body baseline can be proposed by analogy to a scoped body_profile, with endurance-only energy adjustment; identity remains a stable binding and does not alter metrics.

variants.description: flat control profile analogous to scoped 100/80/70 values
variants.calibration_rationale: flat control mirrors the only located scoped profile values, without transferring that profile into runtime

variants.description: candidate proposal: health 100, energy 80 + 2 per endurance point from 10 (clamp 60..100), satiety 70
variants.calibration_rationale: candidate mapping with an explicit endurance sensitivity coefficient for energy; coefficient is a play-balance hypothesis
lower-start sensitivity arm to expose effect of starting reserves; not a historical claim

body_mapping_calibration.evaluation: script-first on 12 explicit synthetic cases; validate bounds, exact mapping outputs, identity binding, persisted-body precedence, missing-input gaps, check/harm boundaries, and 5/6/10-second rational timing. Report all variant outcomes; do not pick a winner, call a model, or change approval status.
body_mapping_calibration.input_contract: Full actor_base_attributes_v1 snapshots are test fixtures produced through the pinned materialization API; the candidate requires the same complete shape and source binding but does not approve these fixtures or values.

script_first_rules: known values use only the matching fixed NPC description
unknown/unreadable values are omitted with a typed gap and never mapped to zero
all integer values 0..100 are exhaustively checked for exactly one covered band
phrases contain no internal calibration metadata or causal/injury assertion
npc_state_description_eval.interpretation_limit: Script checks exact mapping, finite fractional coverage at boundaries, and omission policy. It does not assess naturalness, readability, tone, variation, NPC decisions, or model behavior; those require separate blinded human review.

actor_attributes_fixture.scope: synthetic, deterministic snapshots generated by the pinned actor_base_attributes_v1 materializer for validator and arithmetic checks only; not live NPC records or approval evidence
